entities.summary: Allyssa Lyn Lane is an American professional wrestler. She is signed to All Elite Wrestling (AEW) and Ring of Honor (ROH), where she performs under the ring name Lacey Lane and is a member of CRU. She is best known for her time in WWE, where she performed under the ring name Kayden Carter from 2018 to 2025 and became a one-time and the longest-reigning NXT Women's Tag Team Champion and one-time WWE Women's Tag Team Champion. The two also became the first women's tag team to have won the WWE and NXT Women's Tag Team Championships.
